title: Member of Technical Staff
description: Member of Technical Staff — Mindra Istanbul · On-site · Full-time ABOUT MINDRA Mindra builds budget-aware AI agents for B2C advertisers. Our agents connect ad accounts, attribution, store, and revenue data, then manage budgets across platforms against what actually matters: real store performance, not platform-reported vanity metrics. Teams of agents continuously rebalance and refine cross-platform campaigns to improve efficiency and ROAS. We operate across the US and Turkey and serve customers in 8 countries. We're a small founding team. The person in this seat will shape how our product, our agents, and our engineering culture work for years. THE PROBLEMS YOU'LL WORK ON • Ad platform integrations at scale. Pulling, normalizing, and acting on data from Meta, Google, and other ad platform APIs, including rate limits, schema changes, delayed conversions, and all the mess that comes with them. • Attribution that reflects reality. Reconciling what ad platforms report with what actually happened in the store and in revenue data, and deciding which signal to trust when they disagree. • Budget allocation under uncertainty. Deciding where the next dollar should go across campaigns and platforms, with noisy, lagged, and incomplete data. • Agents that touch real money. Designing agent orchestration, guardrails, and evals for systems that change live budgets for real businesses, where a bad decision has a real cost. • Models of our own. Forecasting, performance prediction, and optimization models that go beyond prompting an LLM. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO • Build across the entire stack: frontend (Next.js/TypeScript), backend (Python), infra (AWS), data pipelines, and the AI layer (agent orchestration, RAG, evals, model routing). Not "full-stack" as a buzzword. You'll touch all of it in a single week. • Train, evaluate, and ship ML models into production, and know when a simple heuristic beats a model. • Own features end to end. You'll take things from "this is broken" or "we need this" through design and shipping, and you'll be on call when it breaks at 3am. • Talk to customers directly. You'll sit with advertisers, understand how they think about spend and returns, and debug with them yourself, without a PM in between. • Make foundational architecture calls. The codebase is small, so what you write now is what everything else gets built on. • Stay on the edge of AI tooling. The space changes weekly. You're already the person who tries a new model the day it drops. WHAT YOU MUST HAVE • Startup experience. You've worked at an early-stage startup or built your own company. You know what it's like when there's no playbook, no spec, and no one else to fix it. • Adtech or performance marketing experience. You've worked with ad platform APIs (Meta, Google, TikTok, etc.), attribution, conversion tracking, or marketing data. You know what ROAS, CPA, and attribution windows mean, and why the numbers never quite match. • 2–3 years of real building. That can be full-time roles, or internships plus serious side projects. Titles don't matter to us. • No silos. You've shipped frontend, written backend, deployed on AWS, and integrated an LLM into something real. "That's not my area" isn't in your vocabulary. • You build without being asked. A side project, a tool you wrote because something annoyed you, a hackathon project that actually worked. We want to see what you make when nobody's telling you to. • Bias to ship. A working version today beats a perfect one next week. You're allergic to over-planning. WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU STAND OUT • You've trained your own models. Not just called an API: you've prepared data, trained, evaluated, and deployed a model yourself, and can explain the trade-offs you made. • Experience with forecasting, recommendation, bandits, or optimization problems. • Familiarity with marketing measurement: incrementality testing, MMM, or multi-touch attribution. • Experience with e-commerce or store data and how it connects to ad performance. • You've built agentic systems and have opinions about evals, tool use, and failure modes. LOGISTICS • Location: Istanbul, on-site • Pace: 996: long days, six days a week. If that sounds like hell, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the most fun you'll ever have building, talk to us. HOW TO APPLY Send us something you've built (a repo, a demo, or a link) and a few lines on why Mindra. If you've worked on adtech or trained your own models, tell us about it, including what went wrong.

title: Yazılım Mimarı
description: Genel Nitelikler Üniversitelerin ilgili bölümlerinden (Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Matematik Mühendisliği vb.) mezun, Oracle PL/SQL ile veritabanı uygulamaları geliştirmede tercihen 8-10 yıl deneyim sahibi, Finans sektöründe ve fon süreçlerinde uygulama geliştirme deneyimine sahip, Tercihen yatırım fonları veya emeklilik yatırım fonlarının işleyişi, kontrol, takas ve operasyonel süreçleri ile ilgili bilgi sahibi, SQL, veri modelleme, performans optimizasyonu ve yüksek hacimli veri işleme (High-Volume Data Processing) konularında güçlü uygulama tecrübesine sahip, API ve sistem entegrasyonları geliştirme tecrübesine sahip; veri tutarlılığı (Data Consistency), eşzamanlı çalışma (Concurrency) ve hata yönetimi konularında deneyim sahibi, Mimari kararlar, iş gereksinimleri, kod, veri dönüşümü, test ve sürüm süreçleri arasında uçtan uca izlenebilirlik kurma ve bu disiplini sürdürme deneyim sahibi, Sistemlerde oluşan hataların kök nedenini (Root Cause Analysis) araştırma ve benzer sorunların tekrarlanmasını önleyecek kalıcı, sürdürülebilir çözümler geliştirme yetkinliğine sahip, Tercihen üretken yapay zeka araçlarını yazılım geliştirme süreçlerinde etkin şekilde kullanan, İş birimleri ve diğer teknik ekiplerle açık ve etkili iletişim kurabilen; karmaşık teknik konuları ve mimari kararları her seviyeden paydaşa açık ve anlaşılır biçimde aktarabilen. İş Tanımı Bilgi Teknolojileri bünyesinde Arka Katman Yazılım Geliştirme Birimi’ne bağlı, yukarıda paylaşılmış niteliklere sahip ve aşağıda yer alan iş tanımı doğrultusunda “Yazılım Mimarı” arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Oracle PL/SQL ile veritabanı uygulama geliştirmeleri yapmak, Fon Gözetimi kapsamında iş hedeflerini, veri akışlarını ve kontrol gereksinimlerini kapsayan güvenli, yüksek performanslı ve ölçeklenebilir hedef mimariler tasarlamak, Güvenlik, ölçeklenebilirlik, sürdürülebilirlik ve Toplam Sahip Olma Maliyeti (TCO) dengesini gözeterek teknoloji ve altyapı süreçlerini değerlendirmek, Yüksek hacimli veri akışları için API ve veri entegrasyon mimarilerini kurgulamak, Kod kalitesi, performans, güvenlik ve sürdürülebilirlik prensiplerine uygun geliştirmeler yapmak, Şirket içi sistem ve yazılım geliştirme görevlerini diğer bölümlerle koordineli olarak yürütmek, Planlama aşamasından canlıya alım sürecine kadar tüm aşamalarda mimari kararların uygulanabilirliğini ve kalitesini denetlemek, Yeni teknolojileri takip ederek kurum ihtiyaçlarına uygun çözüm ve öneriler geliştirmek.

title: Head of Trading Desk Platform (C++)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Trading Desk Platform (C++) based in Turkey. We are seeking an experienced technical leader to take ownership of the core infrastructure powering a newly established proprietary trading desk. In this role, you will design and build a high-performance, low-latency trading platform using modern C++, with a strong focus on system reliability, execution efficiency, and capital protection. You will lead the development of critical components, including the strategy runtime, risk management layer, and order and position management systems. Working closely with senior architecture, quantitative, and data specialists, you will help shape the technical foundations of an ambitious trading operation. The platform will initially integrate with leading cryptocurrency exchanges, with plans to expand into traditional futures and equity markets. This is an opportunity to make significant architectural decisions, drive technical excellence, and have a direct impact on the performance and security of trading operations. Accountabilities Lead the design and development of a robust Strategy SDK with event-driven interfaces for market data, trades, orders, account events, and timers. Build and maintain a high-performance strategy runtime supporting independent execution, monitoring, recovery, and multiple operating modes, including live trading, dry-run, and backtesting. Design and implement comprehensive pre-trade risk controls, including order size limits, price collars, position limits, loss thresholds, and stale-data protection. Develop desk-wide risk monitoring and margin management systems across multiple exchanges to ensure effective oversight of trading exposure. Build reliable order and position management infrastructure, including transaction journaling, crash recovery, exchange reconciliation, and fail-safe mechanisms. Implement kill switches and automated risk controls to safeguard trading capital and prevent unintended trading activity. Develop and maintain exchange connectors, starting with Binance, using a scalable and shared connectivity framework. Ensure consistent and deterministic strategy execution across backtesting, simulation, and live trading environments. Collaborate closely with the HFT Architecture Lead and data engineering team to align platform development with system architecture, exchange connectivity, and backtesting infrastructure. Establish and maintain high standards for system reliability, testing, documentation, maintainability, and developer experience. Requirements Strong proficiency in modern C++, particularly C++17 and C++20, with experience developing production-grade software. Extensive experience designing and building high-performance, event-driven systems, ideally in trading or other latency-sensitive environments. Deep understanding of trading system fundamentals, including order lifecycles, position management, profit and loss (PnL), margin requirements, and liquidation mechanisms. Proven experience developing and operating production-grade risk management systems, order management systems, or trading infrastructure. Hands-on experience with exchange connectivity, including market data feeds and order execution APIs, across cryptocurrency or traditional financial markets. Strong understanding of system correctness, deterministic execution, fault tolerance, crash recovery, and operational resilience. Ability to design clean, scalable APIs and developer-friendly interfaces that support efficient strategy development. Strong technical ownership, problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to work independently within a small, highly experienced engineering team. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively alongside architects, quantitative researchers, and other technical specialists. Nice To Have Previous experience working at a proprietary trading firm, high-frequency trading (HFT) firm, market maker, or financial exchange. Experience developing market-making, arbitrage, or cross-exchange trading systems. Knowledge of cross-venue risk management, collateral optimization, and multi-exchange trading operations. Python programming experience for tooling, automation, and infrastructure development. Benefits Competitive salary: Annual compensation ranging from $200,000 to $250,000. Fully remote working: Work remotely with flexibility across EST–CET time zones. Flexible location: Ideally based in Cyprus, with openness to candidates across the EST–CET time zones. Permanent employment: Long-term opportunity within an ambitious and technically driven environment. Paid annual leave: 24 days of annual leave. Full-time position: 40 hours per week. Significant technical ownership: Opportunity to shape a proprietary trading platform from the ground up and influence critical architectural and engineering decisions. Experienced team: Work alongside senior professionals in trading architecture, quantitative development, and data engineering. Career impact: Contribute directly to building high-performance trading infrastructure with opportunities for future expansion into additional financial markets. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether?
